about: Song sections corrected from their chord sheets, approved by the maintainer 2026-10-24 (T410). Chords are as each sheet writes them (capo shapes where the sheet uses a capo; the numerals are the same). `npm run chords -- respell` spells every song from these where given, and from the shipped credits otherwise, by AC-2.6.1/19. A song listed here has all its credits taken from here.

songs.title: Reckoner
songs.why: Bridge: the sheet has C Em B, nothing like the shipped iii–i–iv–♭VImaj7–V.

songs.title: I Need My Girl
songs.why: The sheet's verse is Am F C and its chorus F Am G; the shipped loop added a fourth chord to both.

songs.title: England
songs.why: The sheet has Dm7, which puts the loop in C, and its fourth chord minor.

songs.title: Terrible Love
songs.why: Bridge: the sheet has Em G Bm D.

songs.title: Guilty Party
songs.why: Verse: the sheet has D F#m Bm Em7 D A.

songs.title: Conversation 16
songs.why: Chorus: the sheet has Bm D G.

songs.title: Jesus, Etc.
songs.why: Chorus: the sheet has C Am Am(maj7) F C G, a falling line where the shipped loop had a III.

songs.title: Holocene
songs.why: Verse: the sheet has G Em D Em C, with the vi returning before the IV.

songs.title: The Scientist
songs.why: Verse: the sheet (capo 3) has Bm7 G D Dsus2, so the last chord is the tonic suspended, not the V.

songs.title: My Universe
songs.why: The sheet (capo 2) has G D A throughout, IV–I–V, not IV–vi–V.

songs.title: Clocks
songs.why: Outro: the sheet (capo 1) has Fmaj7 C G, which lies in its own key.

songs.title: It Ain’t Me Babe
songs.why: Verse: the sheet has G C G D.
